''See also: [[Tyril Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Tyril is a member of the High [[Council]] and holds the title of High Shepherd. Originally from the Shepherds, he possesses a background that suggests time spent living in the wild, characterized by a long, unkempt gray beard and a thin physical frame. In his official capacity, he has been observed wearing fine black clothing with a groomed appearance, displaying more energy than in his more casual, ragged state. As a [[High Councilor]], he works alongside others to provide support through the [[Consultant's Guild]], specifically regarding the succession of an Emperor or [[Empress]]. During political proceedings, he has expressed a desire to avoid the execution of talented individuals.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Tyril wears black clothing and does not have a shroud covering his face. He has been seen resting in a chair or leaning against a wall to catch his breath.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Tyril is a fighter who utilizes a knife in combat. He also possesses the physical strength required to drag Yala the High Mason{{!}}Yala away.}}

== Of Shadow and Sea ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|As a [[High Councilor]], Tyril serves as the third and final member of his governing body. During combat, he operates as a fighter who utilizes a knife for his strikes. At one point, he was observed leaning against a wall while attempting to catch his breath. Later, he was found napping in his chair.}}
